patterns.problem: Choose a working layout that balances the garment preview, discoverable tools and learning effort.

options.label: Large preview, tools when needed
options.benefit: The clothing preview stays central and uncluttered.
options.tradeoff: New users may overlook controls until helped by onboarding.
options.when: Frequent creation, mobile space constraints, visual manipulation.
options.verify: Measure completion and accidental tool switching; test discoverability on first use.

options.label: Permanent studio panels
options.benefit: All layers and controls are visible for complex editing.
options.tradeoff: Smaller preview and more visual effort, especially on phones.
options.when: Experienced designers and complex multi-layer sessions.
options.verify: Compare time to locate tools and task completion for newcomers and experienced users.

options.label: Guided step-by-step design
options.benefit: A beginner knows what to do next and can finish a first garment.
options.tradeoff: Frequent editing may become slower, and jumping between steps needs care.
options.when: First-run workflows and narrow single-purpose products.
options.verify: Test first garment completion, repeat edits and back-navigation without losing work.

patterns.problem: Explain the product or creator's value at first glance while maintaining a distinctive visual identity.

options.label: Show credible work immediately
options.benefit: Visitors can judge work and results without hunting.
options.tradeoff: A visually dense first screen risks overwhelming visitors.
options.when: Conversion to enquiries or employment is the principal outcome.
options.verify: Observe whether visitors can identify expertise and find a relevant project in seconds.

options.label: Distinctive editorial introduction
options.benefit: Memorable personality and visual rhythm support a personal brand.
options.tradeoff: May bury practical evidence unless project access stays obvious.
options.when: Creative differentiation is central to the visitor's decision.
options.verify: Measure first-screen understanding, project discovery and mobile navigation.

options.label: Clear introduction plus proof
options.benefit: Balances personality with evidence and a direct next step.
options.tradeoff: Needs disciplined content hierarchy to avoid clutter.
options.when: Broad audiences include recruiters, buyers and potential collaborators.
options.verify: Check clarity, accessibility, project clickthrough and contact intent.

patterns.problem: Reduce avoidable mistakes while helping people recover and complete tasks.

options.label: One clear page
options.benefit: People can see the whole task and edit information freely.
options.tradeoff: Long forms can feel intimidating.
options.when: Short forms and users who need to compare fields.
options.verify: Test errors, keyboard use and actual completion.

options.label: Reveal only what is needed
options.benefit: Reduces initial complexity while maintaining the full workflow.
options.tradeoff: Hidden fields and state transitions can surprise people.
options.when: Conditional forms with many irrelevant questions.
options.verify: Test branching paths, validation, focus and backtracking.

options.label: Clearly labelled steps
options.benefit: Complex tasks feel manageable and progress is visible.
options.tradeoff: Requires reliable save and back behavior.
options.when: Long submissions that have distinct phases.
options.verify: Test returning to earlier steps, recovery after interruption and total time.

patterns.problem: Help people identify what needs attention and act without navigating blindly.

options.label: Problems and actions first
options.benefit: Urgent work becomes obvious.
options.tradeoff: May hide broader patterns and context.
options.when: Operational teams responding to incidents or requests.
options.verify: Measure time from alert to action, missed critical cases and false alarms.

options.label: Overview and trends first
options.benefit: Supports understanding performance and trends.
options.tradeoff: Can delay immediate action if poorly prioritized.
options.when: Periodic management and review tasks.
options.verify: Test whether users can identify a trend and locate its underlying records.

options.label: Searchable records first
options.benefit: Makes detailed investigation and editing fast.
options.tradeoff: New users can struggle without summary cues.
options.when: Frequent individual record lookup and correction.
options.verify: Measure findability, edit errors, accessible sorting and filtering.

patterns.problem: Choose failure handling that keeps outcomes correct when an external request or background job fails.

options.label: Retry safely with a stable request identity
options.benefit: Transient failures can recover without repeating an intended result.
options.tradeoff: Requires tracking attempts and correctly defining a unique action.
options.when: Repeatable operations with bounded external failures.
options.verify: Force duplicate requests, partial failures and timeout-after-success scenarios.

options.label: Save work before sending it
options.benefit: Work survives interruption between a local decision and external delivery.
options.tradeoff: Adds a worker, lifecycle monitoring and replay handling.
options.when: Reliable event delivery or external side effects are necessary.
options.verify: Kill execution between writing and sending, replay events, and verify exactly one intended business outcome.

options.label: Stop and request review when uncertain
options.benefit: Prevents unsafe automatic repeats for irreversible or ambiguous outcomes.
options.tradeoff: More operational effort and slower resolution.
options.when: Money, destructive changes or unknown external outcomes.
options.verify: Simulate ambiguous provider responses and verify safe hold plus clear resolution path.

patterns.problem: Pick the simplest state model that keeps users' edits and server data consistent.

options.label: Local ownership for temporary edits
options.benefit: Minimal dependencies and clear control over an isolated interaction.
options.tradeoff: Can become difficult when unrelated screens need the same state.
options.when: Ephemeral editor controls and one-screen interactions.
options.verify: Test reset, undo, switching tasks and loss of unsaved work.

options.label: Server data cache with explicit refresh
options.benefit: Reusable asynchronous data and coherent loading/error behavior.
options.tradeoff: Cache invalidation and optimistic updates need clear policies.
options.when: Many views share changing server information.
options.verify: Test stale data, request failure, optimistic rollback and switching accounts.

options.label: One editable document with derived views
options.benefit: Multiple previews reflect the same saved source.
options.tradeoff: Document versioning and migration require careful design.
options.when: Editors have multiple modes, undo/redo, save/reopen and exports.
options.verify: Round-trip save/reopen, concurrent editing and view consistency.

patterns.problem: Choose proportionate checks and change scope while protecting existing behavior.

options.label: Check the changed behavior first
options.benefit: Fast feedback for a small, well-isolated change.
options.tradeoff: May miss integration breakages.
options.when: Small changes with understood boundaries.
options.verify: Run affected tests and inspect nearby contracts and failure cases.

options.label: Test the parts working together
options.benefit: Finds failures at component and service boundaries.
options.tradeoff: Slower setup and more complicated test environments.
options.when: API, persistence, payments or multiple services change together.
options.verify: Test real boundary interactions, idempotency and fallback.

options.label: Check the full user journey
options.benefit: Catches user-visible breaks that unit checks may miss.
options.tradeoff: More expensive and subject to environment variability.
options.when: Major workflow, UX or release-boundary changes.
options.verify: Test complete desktop/mobile journey and negative states with recorded evidence.
